headline: FROGGER: two-player duel, the row-entry breath, arcade time bonus
lede: The never-dry audit picked FROGGER as the weakest title on the shelf and shipped its oldest honest gap in one pass: press 2 at the title for the arcade's alternating duel, every new row now holds the field for a beat like the 1981 cabinet, and homes pay ten points per unused half-second.

notes.text: #3676 shipped via PR #3684 (30ca7c3): alternating 2P on the same board (homes persist across the handoff), dual-score HUD with the active seat bright, WINS/DRAW verdict — sourced to Wikipedia §Gameplay.

The row-entry tell pauses field AND clock for 18 ticks on every new row — and is deliberately exempt under the watch seat so the certified planner's tick-for-tick math (and its #2869/#1776 pins) stays byte-identical.

Proof: froggercheck 61/0 (+21), six new mutants 6/6 dead via a new --mutant-only slice flag, and froggerdueldrive 10/10 in real Chrome. A hand-break of the handoff gate went exactly red before restore.
Bug caught on the seat drive: landing on a filled home splatted while the event bag said 'home' — the jingle played over the death. It now reports its own wall-death with a flat bonk.
